subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, which of the following states recorded negative growth in child sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Maharastra recorded a negative growth in child sex ratio according to Census 2011.
 
• Maharashtra experienced a decline in the child sex ratio between 2001 and 2011, dropping from 913 to 894 girls per 1,000 boys. This marks a negative growth in the ratio for the state.
 
• This decline indicates a worsening gender imbalance among children aged 0-6 years in the state.
 
• The state government has implemented various schemes to address this issue, but the decline reflects ongoing challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Sex Ratio (CSR)**

 
 
• The Child Sex Ratio (CSR) is defined as the number of girls per 1,000 boys in the age group of 0-6 years.
 
• It is an important indicator of gender equality in a society.
 
• A declining CSR is a matter of concern as it reflects gender biases and societal preferences for male children.
 
 
 
• **Factors Affecting CSR**
 
 
• Societal preference for male children due to cultural and economic reasons.
 
• Sex-selective abortions facilitated by advances in medical technology.
 
• Neglect and discrimination against girl children in terms of healthcare, nutrition, and education.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives**
 
 
• Programs like Beti Bachao Beti Padhao aim to improve the CSR by addressing gender discrimination and promoting the education of girl children.
 
• Strict implementation of the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PCPNDT) Act to prevent sex-selective abortions.
 
• Awareness campaigns to change societal attitudes towards girl children.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Negative CSR**
 
 
• Long-term demographic imbalance.
 
• Increased violence against women and human trafficking.
 
• Social issues arising from a skewed gender ratio.
